dosing.mania: 100-200 mg once/twice daily, titrate to 400-600 mg/day by day 4-7, increase by 200 mg/day every 1-2 days to target 800-1200 mg/day (max 1600 mg/day in some protocols)

hyponatremia.note: SIADH-type hyponatremia, incidence up to ~10-13% in some cohorts (higher in elderly); check sodium 2-4 weeks after initiation or dose increase

rash_SJS.note: Serious rash risk ~1-3 in 10,000 in general population; much higher in carriers of HLA-B*1502 (East Asian ancestry) - screen before starting in Han Chinese, Thai, Malaysian, and other Asian populations with known allele frequency

other: CYP3A4 inducer (many DDIs: reduces OCP efficacy, warfarin, haloperidol, lamotrigine levels)
